item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=What+is+the+trade-off+between+predictive+accuracy+and+energy+dissipation+for+a+physical+system+with+constrained+memory+retention+time%3F&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1103/physreve.108.l052103\", \"title\": [\"Speed limit, dissipation bound, and dissipation-time trade-off in thermal relaxation processes\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1103/physreve.108.l052103\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2023, 11, 6]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6346450\", \"title\": [\"Zero-Overhead GreenPatch: Breaking the Energy-Accuracy Trade-off in Scalable Multivariate Time Series Forecasting\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Deep learning models for time series forecasting (TSF), particularly Transformers, deliver strong accuracy but impose prohibitive computational overhead that limits edge deployment. Traditional machine learning methods such as XGBoost, while efficient on low-dimensional data, fail on large-scale multivariate datasets due to input dimensionality explosion. This paper proposes GreenPatch, a model-agnostic wrapper that applies a zero-overhead, lossless tensor reshape - [B, L, C] -> [B, L/F, C x F] - to compress the temporal dimension by a factor F prior to inference, requiring no architectural modifications or retraining. Comprehensive experiments across eight benchmark datasets (ETTh1/h2, ETTm1/m2, Electricity, Weather, Traffic, National Illness), five deep learning architectures, and an XGBoost baseline demonstrate that GreenPatch reduces Transformer FLOPs by ~75%, achieves energy savings of up to 29.3%, and simultaneously improves MAE by up to 43.95% on large-scale multivariate data. Statistical significance is confirmed via paired t-tests across five random seeds (p < 0.001 in key cases). The Continuity Hypothesis is introduced to explain the asymmetric architecture-dependent behavior: GreenPatch acts as a macro-level noise filter that benefits attention mechanisms while disrupting the micro-level temporal continuity exploited by linear models. These findings establish GreenPatch as a practical, principled tool for sustainable deployment of TSF models in energy-constrained environments.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6346450\", \"published\": {…
